newsitem.title: JAPAN: Yaohan-Japan may face further struggle - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Yaohan-Japan may face further struggle - analysts.

text.p: Troubled Japanese retailer Yaohan Japan Corp still faces problems despite the planned sale of some of its supermarkets, the latest of its efforts to emerge from a mountain of debt, analysts said on Friday.
"Yaohan will probably have to slim down its business further, and it may even reduce its capital," said one retail analyst who declined to be named.
The company said on Monday it would sell 16 of 56 stores it runs in Japan to major retailer Daiei Inc in order to reduce its hefty borrowings.
"With the store sales, it will at least be able to redeem convertible bonds in May," said another analyst at a brokerge affiliated think-tank.
The bonds are worth 9.8 billion yen.
But the stores being sold are some of the most profitable in the Yaohan chain, and the company will lose a major part of its operating profit by selling them, retail analysts said.
A Yaohan spokesman said on Friday that the company believed the sale of its outlets would help it boost profits.

"The sale of the outlets is in line with our management policy to seek bigger profits rather than expand sales," he said. "The outlet sales will work positively in boosting profits by giving us a way to seek efficiency."
The 16 stores to be sold to Daiei are expected to register aggregate sales of 67.4 billion yen in the year to February 28. Total sales of the chain are expected to be 166 billion yen.
"In order to be profitable with what's left in the chain, the company will have to remodel stores. But it would be difficult to raise money," said a brokerage-affiliated analyst.

Seiki Orimi, an analyst at Dai-ichi Securities Co, said the death of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping this week could affect Yaohan's Chinese operations if conservative forces in the government gained influence and altered economic policy.
But he said Yaohan still had sound management and a distinctive business strategy.
Earlier this month, Yaohan announced a broad restructuring programme in order to revive its profits.
Yaohan Japan is the flagship of the Yaohan international retailing group, which has aggressively expanded overseas, especially in China.
